# `foxglove config get`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](config.md)

```text
Get a configuration value. FOXGLOVE_DEFAULT_PROJECT_ID, when set, takes precedence over project-id in the config file.

Usage: foxglove config get [OPTIONS] <KEY>

Arguments:
  <KEY>
          [possible values: project-id]

Options:
      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --config <CONFIG>
          Config file

      --debug[=<DEBUG>]
          Print debug diagnostics, including HTTP requests, to stderr

          [default: false]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```
